title: ConnectorAction
description: dispatch -> connector. Exactly one instructed step. The connector executes this verb against the local controller and nothing else. args is validated against the existing frozen per-verb request schema.

action_id.description: Idempotency key for this single step. Replaying the same action_id must return a cached result instead of re-executing a side effect.

args.description: Verb-specific request body. Must independently validate against contracts/sandbox/<verb>.request.json. No arbitrary shell or kubectl operation is legal.
